entries.reviewNotes: Read Japanese context, all eleven turns and five hints across twelve locales. Checked folded versus spread tripod, outside-fence photography and pedestrian priority; corrected Chinese wording implying entry inside the fence.

changes.before: 我会从围栏外拍。也想让朋友站进去拍，可以在花前停下吗？
changes.after: 我会从围栏外拍。也想请朋友站好让我拍照，可以在花前停留一下吗？
changes.reason: Japanese asks friend to pose outside the fence; 站进去 implies entering the prohibited fenced area.

changes.before: 我會從圍欄外拍。也想讓朋友站進去拍，可以在花前停下嗎？
changes.after: 我會從圍欄外拍。也想請朋友站好讓我拍照，可以在花前停留一下嗎？
changes.reason: Japanese asks friend to pose outside the fence; 站进去 implies entering the prohibited fenced area.

changes.before: Do not try to let them through regardless; call me using the phone inside reception.
changes.after: Do not let the vehicles through if you cannot confirm the details; call me using the phone inside reception.
changes.reason: Render 無理に通さず naturally as withholding passage when confirmation is unclear, consistent with the radio failure context.

changes.before: Xin xem ghi chép và giấy tờ danh tính. Lần cuối dùng thẻ khi nào?
changes.after: Cho tôi xem thông tin đã ghi lại và giấy tờ tùy thân của bạn. Bạn dùng thẻ lần cuối khi nào?
changes.reason: Use natural Vietnamese for the account-number record and identity documents while preserving the staff request and last-use question.

changes.before: छ। भवन नाम लामो छ, कोठाबाहिर लेख्न मिल्छ?
changes.after: छ। भवनको नाम लामो छ, फारमको कोष्ठबाहिर पनि लेख्न मिल्छ?
changes.reason: Clarify that the learner asks to write outside the form field, not outside a physical room; retain the long building name context.

changes.before: ถ้าอย่างนั้นไม่เดินรอบ ไปแค่ก่อนถึงสระแล้วกลับค่ะ
changes.after: ถ้าอย่างนั้นจะไม่เดินรอบสระ แต่จะไปถึงริมสระฝั่งใกล้แล้วกลับค่ะ
changes.reason: The agreed route reaches the near bank of the pond; the previous Thai said to stop before reaching the pond, losing the scenery goal.

changes.before: 取出袋子，用烤麵包機短時間加熱，注意別烤焦。
changes.after: 把麵包從袋子裡取出，用烤麵包機短時間加熱，注意別烤焦。
changes.reason: The instruction is to remove bread from its bag before reheating; 取出袋子 literally tells the learner to take out the bag instead.

changes.before: अहिले दुखेको छैन। बेहोस गर्ने औषधिले ओठको महसुस अझै लाटो छ।
changes.after: अहिले दुखेको छैन। लट्ठ्याउने औषधिको असरले ओठ अझै सुन्न छ।
changes.reason: The dental context describes a numb lip from local anesthetic; avoid saying medicine to render the patient unconscious.

changes.before: মুরগি বাদ দিয়ে টোফুতে ডিম চান। জাপানি ভাষায় বলুন।
changes.after: ভাজা মুরগি না নিয়ে ঠান্ডা টোফুতে ডিম ব্যবহার হয় কি না জিজ্ঞেস করুন। জাপানি ভাষায় বলুন।
changes.reason: The task asks whether chilled tofu uses egg; the previous Bengali literally requested egg in tofu, reversing the allergic diner’s intent.

changes.before: ဖလက်ရှ်ပိတ်ပါမယ်။ ရှင်းလင်းစာရွက်လေ့လာပြီးမှ ယူလို့ရလား။
changes.after: ဖလက်ရှ်ပိတ်ပါမယ်။ ပြသပစ္စည်းတွေ ကြည့်ပြီးမှ ရှင်းလင်းစာရွက် ယူလို့ရလား။
changes.reason: The visitor asks to collect the explanation sheet after viewing exhibits, not after studying the sheet itself; restore the correct sequence.

changes.before: ডিমের অ্যালার্জি বলে নুডলস-ঝোলের ডিম চান। জাপানি ভাষায় বলুন।
changes.after: ডিমে অ্যালার্জির কথা বলে কাকে উদনের নুডলস ও ঝোলে ডিম আছে কি না জিজ্ঞেস করুন। জাপানি ভাষায় বলুন।
changes.reason: Ask whether egg is present instead of requesting egg in the noodles and broth; preserve the allergy consultation task.

changes.before: 是的，不能保证完全不混蛋。
changes.after: 是的，无法保证不会混入鸡蛋。
changes.reason: Use natural wording for possible egg cross-contact; 混蛋 is a common insult and an unsuitable contraction of 混入鸡蛋.

changes.before: Chọn loại không dây giá 1280, từ chối túi. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.after: Chọn bộ sạc giá 1280 yên không kèm cáp và từ chối túi. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.reason: Không dây can mean wireless; this is a wired wall adapter sold without an included cable, used with the existing USB-A cable.

changes.before: 选无线1280商品，拒袋。请用日语表达。
changes.after: 选择不附充电线的1280日元商品，并谢绝袋子。请用日语表达。
changes.reason: Without an included cable is not wireless charging; clarify the adapter package contents and preserve bag refusal.

changes.before: 選無線1280商品，拒袋。請用日語表達。
changes.after: 選擇不附充電線的1280日圓商品，並婉拒袋子。請用日語表達。
changes.reason: Without an included cable is not wireless charging; clarify the adapter package contents and preserve bag refusal.

changes.before: 请看明细，饮料我们两人各一杯。
changes.after: 请给我看一下明细。我们两人各点了一杯饮料。
changes.reason: The diner asks staff to show the itemized bill, rather than telling staff to look at it; preserve the two single drinks.

changes.before: Sa kuhaan ng hindi nagamit na label. Ngayon lang ang nasa mesa.
changes.after: Ilagay sa kahong pangkolekta ng mga hindi nagamit na label. Ang bungkos para sa araw na ito lang ang iwan sa mesa.
changes.reason: Unused labels go into a collection box, not a pickup location; clarify that only today’s bundle remains on the workbench.

changes.before: Hello. Today's shrine stamps are these paper versions.
changes.after: Hello. Today's temple goshuin stamps are these paper versions.
changes.reason: This scenario is explicitly set at a temple; avoid recasting its goshuin as a shrine-only stamp in the dialogue or task.

changes.before: Request one paper shrine stamp and ask about the date. Say it in Japanese.
changes.after: Request one paper goshuin stamp and ask about the date. Say it in Japanese.
changes.reason: This scenario is explicitly set at a temple; avoid recasting its goshuin as a shrine-only stamp in the dialogue or task.

scope: AI Japanese context and all12 sentence/task sets; native/source/device approval separate.
